X_ITE sorts splats inside one GaussianSplats node, but draws the nodes themselves like transparent shapes
cutting in file order scored 20.1% on the 500,000-splat Pantheon and a kd cut 1.1%; octree and grid scored 0.5 to 0.8%, and kd was chosen anyway for balanced chunk sizes and the fewest files.
bbox_mode | cull_safe (default): each node's centre is its own splats' centre and its size covers the whole scene, so a viewer never culls a node.
